premises.text: Medication non-adherence is a significant issue for respiratory patients
premises.evidence_span: $80 billion is spent each year treating respiratory illness, of which half of that is attributed to medication non-adherence

premises.text: Current respiratory devices are outdated and not user-friendly
premises.evidence_span: bulky and intimidating spirometer, a device that has not evolved in function or form since it was first introduced in 1840

premises.text: Smart respiratory devices can improve patient adherence and outcomes
premises.evidence_span: we at Cohero Health are making respiratory devices data smart to enable improved adherence, leading to better patient outcomes for pulmonary patients

premises.text: Wireless medication inhaler sensors can track medication utilization in real time
premises.evidence_span: we enable her with wireless medication inhaler sensors to track her medication utilization and adherence in real time

premises.text: A mobile spirometer can measure lung function from home
premises.evidence_span: a clinical-grade and ultra-portable mobile spirometer, which measures her lung function from home

premises.text: A connected health platform can provide insights for both patients and doctors
premises.evidence_span: he's able to look at adherence and spirometry data in an easy snapshot to enable optimal decision-making

premises.text: The system can significantly increase medication adherence and reduce emergency room visits
premises.evidence_span: we were able to demonstrate two and a half times increase in medication adherence over the standard of care

value.text: Patients gain better control over their respiratory health through smart technology
value.evidence_span: empowering respiratory patients to take control of their treatment
